# Tunisian fans back national team to overcome tough World Cup group
Supporters remain hopeful Tunisia can advance despite facing Netherlands, Japan and Sweden
Adel Elthabti
08 June 2026•Update: 08 June 2026
Content media
[...]
TUNIS, Tunisia
[...]
Tunisian football fans expressed confidence in their national team’s ability to progress at the 2026 FIFA World Cup despite being drawn into a difficult group featuring the Netherlands, Japan and Sweden.
[...]
Tunisia is currently holding a training camp abroad ahead of its tournament opener against Sweden on June 15 in Monterrey, Mexico.
[...]
After opening against Sweden, Tunisia will take on Japan on June 21 in Monterrey before facing the Netherlands on June 26 in Kansas City.
[...]
## ‘We believe in our team’
[...]
Abdelwahed Chebbi, 65, said Tunisia’s performance against Austria gave supporters reasons for optimism despite the defeat.
[...]
“Austria is a strong team, and we only lost 1-0, while other teams suffered heavier defeats,” he told Anadolu.
[...]
“The upcoming matches will be difficult, but the players must show fighting spirit,” he added.
[...]
Chebbi also recalled Tunisia’s 3-0 victory over Japan in the 2022 Kirin Cup, saying the team is capable of producing strong performances against major opponents.
[...]
“With determination and pride in the national jersey, we can qualify for the next round,” he said.
[...]
‘Football is
[...]
Eighteen-year-old supporter Chadi Mdouri acknowledged the strength of Tunisia’s opponents but insisted qualification remains possible.
[...]
“The Netherlands has world-class players, while Japan and Sweden are also strong teams,” he said.
[...]
“But football is unpredictable, and Tunisia can still achieve positive results.”
[...]
Another fan, Youssef Ben Hussein, 70, shared similar optimism despite describing Tunisia’s group as “very difficult.”
[...]
“Football does not follow calculations,” he said. “We must hold on to our chances and compete with confidence.”
[...]
Belkacem Rahmouni, 42, called on the national team to adopt an attacking approach during the tournament.
[...]
“We have talented players and we should trust our abilities,” he said, urging fans to continue supporting the team instead of criticizing players.
[...]
At Qatar 2022, Tunisia stunned defending champions France with a 1-0 victory but failed to advance to the knockout stage after losing to Australia.

results.title: World Cup: Tunisia vs France Head to Head & Odds at PS!
highlights:
With their 2-1 win over Denmark, France became the first World Cup defending champions to advance to the knockout stage since Brazil in 2006. While qualification is already secured, Les Bleus just need a point vs. Tunisia to clinch the group. Tunisia have sat back often during the tournament but they’ll need to go all out to win to stay alive. We’ll review the latest odds and news in this Tunisia vs France head to head matchup.
[...]
Tunisia have been one of the most defensive-minded teams at the World Cup. They play with five
[...]
1-
[...]
They’ll need to pull off a massive upset to stay in the FIFA World Cup 2022, which could involve a shift in strategy. Coach Jalel Kadri is unlikely to completely switch around his lineup as playing a more attacking game could leave Tunisia vulnerable. Expect substitutions and for French-born striker Wahbi Khazri to play a part. Montpellier’s Khazri has started on the bench in both matches but is Tunisia’s second-leading scorer of all-time.
[...]
Injuries to France’s key players N’Golo Kante, Paul Pogba and Karim Benzema tempered their expectations for the tournament. Many wondered whether Les Bleus would succumb to the same fate as prior defending champions. So far, France have silenced all of the doubters and managed to win their first two matches. France became the first team in the tournament to clinch knockout stage qualification, with a 2-1 win over Denmark. Les Bleus avoided a third straight defeat to Denmark in the process and
[...]
Heading into Wednesday’s match, France are one-goal favorites and sit at -105 odds to cover. Tunisia are implied to be more likely to cover, at -115 but recall that a draw does nothing for them here. Expect Tunisia to throw numbers forward towards the end of the match if they’re trailing or tied. A draw comes in at +285 odds and has occurred two of the last three times these teams have met.
[...]
The Tunisia vs. France head to head odds also price France as -180 moneyline favorites. If they’re able to win it’ll be the first time they finish a group stage perfect since 1998. That year, they won the World Cup as hosts.
[...]
Tunisia come in at a +575 price to win but they’re way more likely to fail to score. A France shutout sits at even odds and it’d be the first time ever Tunisia fail to score at a World Cup.
[...]
It’s possible that France find it difficult to break Tunisia down. Also don’t discount France coach Didier Deschamps shuffling around the lineup a bit to rest some of his key guys for the round of 16. France have one of the deepest teams in the tournament so it shouldn’t be too big of a drop off. It’ll certainly be interesting to see if Tunisia can hang around long enough to push for a winner.

Tunisia arrive at the 2026 FIFA World Cup as one of Africa’s most experienced World Cup nations, making their sixth appearance at the tournament. The Eagles of Carthage carry a rich footballing tradition and a squad featuring players from European leagues who bring technical quality to a tactically organized national team setup.

Their 2022 World Cup — where they won their group match against France but were eliminated on results — demonstrated that Tunisia can compete and beat top-level opposition on their day.

Tunisia play in a disciplined, organized system that prioritizes defensive structure, midfield work rate, and exploiting pace on the counter.
